arguments.script: var setup=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.GetSceneManagerSetup();var rows=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();rows.Add("CURRENT "+UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().path+" dirty="+UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().isDirty);try{foreach(var e in UnityEditor.EditorBuildSettings.scenes.Where(e=>e.enabled&&!e.path.Contains("MainMenu"))){var sc=UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(e.path);foreach(var r in sc.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>(true)).Where(r=>r.name.StartsWith("Tube")||r.name.StartsWith("StairsBlock"))){var rb=r.GetComponentInParent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>();rows.Add(sc.name+"|"+r.name+"|"+r.bounds.ToString("F3")+"|"+string.Join(",",r.GetComponents<UnityEngine.Component>().Select(c=>c.GetType().Name))+"|body="+(rb==null?"none":rb.bodyType.ToString())+"|colliders="+string.Join(";",r.GetComponents<UnityEngine.Collider2D>().Select(c=>c.GetType().Name+":"+c.bounds.ToString("F3"))));}}}finally{UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.RestoreSceneManagerSetup(setup);}System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/tilemap-pillars-20261110/inventory.txt",rows);return string.Join("\n",rows.Take(18));
arguments.summary: Inspect static pillar and stair bodies before tile conversion
